ideas.title: Nginx Proxies a WebSocket Endpoint but the Client Fails the Upgrade with `400 Bad Request`
ideas.description: Fix WebSocket proxying by forwarding the upgrade headers and using the right HTTP version.
ideas.angle: Describe how Nginx strips upgrade semantics unless `proxy_http_version 1.1` and the `Upgrade` and `Connection` headers are forwarded correctly. Explain why the backend sees a normal HTTP request instead of a WebSocket handshake, and include the exact location block needed to preserve the upgrade.

ideas.title: SvelteKit Breaks Prerender with "window is not defined" When a Server File Imports Browser Code
ideas.description: Prerendered SvelteKit pages crash when server-side code pulls in a browser-only module that touches `window` during build.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact prerender/build error and name the file that imports the browser-only dependency. Explain how SvelteKit evaluates server modules during prerender and why `window` is missing there. Show how to move the import behind `onMount`, `if (browser)`, or a `.client` boundary so prerender can complete.

ideas.title: React Native Android Fails with "Unable to resolve module" After a Native Package Is Added to the Bundle
ideas.description: A release build can fail when Metro cannot bundle a dependency that imports Node or unlinked native code.
ideas.angle: Start with the bundler error as it appears in Android build output and identify the imported package. Explain how Metro resolves dependencies, why a package with native or Node-specific entry points breaks the bundle, and how autolinking or platform-specific imports change the result. Show how to verify the package’s entry points and replace the import with a supported native module or a web-safe alternative.

ideas.title: Express Rejects Stripe Webhooks with a Signature Mismatch When JSON Middleware Consumes the Raw Body
ideas.description: Stripe signature verification fails when Express parses the request body before you compute the webhook HMAC.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact Stripe signature verification error and the route that fails. Explain why `express.json()` changes the request stream and breaks HMAC verification, since the signature must be computed from the raw bytes. Show how to mount `express.raw({ type: 'application/json' })` on the webhook route and keep JSON parsing for the rest of the app.

ideas.title: Hono Loses Session Cookies on Cross-Origin Requests Because `fetch` Never Sends Credentials
ideas.description: Cookie-based auth fails when browser requests omit credentials or the response omits the correct CORS cookie headers.
ideas.angle: Open with the symptom the browser shows: the API responds, but the session cookie never persists or is never sent back. Explain the browser rules behind credentialed requests, `SameSite`, `Secure`, and the required `Access-Control-Allow-Credentials` plus exact origin header. Show how to configure Hono CORS, set cookies correctly, and verify the request includes `credentials: 'include'`.

ideas.title: Nuxt Ignores a Client-Only Widget During Static Generation Because the Page Was Rendered at Build Time
ideas.description: A widget that depends on browser APIs disappears or fails when Nuxt prerenders the page as static HTML.
ideas.angle: Open with the static-generation symptom and the page or component that fails to render as expected. Explain how Nuxt prerendering runs without a browser, why client-only code is stripped or deferred, and how that affects hydration and HTML output. Show when to use `<ClientOnly>`, page-level prerender settings, or route rules so the widget survives deployment.

ideas.title: Docker Cannot Reach Postgres on localhost Because the App Container Resolves Its Own Loopback Interface
ideas.description: A containerized app fails to connect to `localhost` because `127.0.0.1` points at the container, not the database host.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact connection error and the host string in the config. Explain container network namespaces, why `localhost` inside a container never means the host machine or another service, and how Compose service DNS changes the address you must use. Show how to point the app at the Postgres service name, expose ports only when needed, and confirm readiness separately from reachability.

ideas.title: Vite Refuses a CSS Import from `node_modules` with "does not exist under root" During Build
ideas.description: A production build can fail when a stylesheet import points outside Vite’s project root or references an unsupported path.
ideas.angle: Open with the exact Vite build error and the import path that triggers it. Explain how Vite’s root-based file serving and dependency scanning limit which files can be imported directly, and why some package asset paths work in dev but fail in build. Show how to import CSS through the package entry point, adjust `server.fs.allow` only when appropriate, or copy the asset into the app’s source tree.

drafted.title: Docker Compose Starts an API Before Postgres Is Ready and the App Logs `ECONNREFUSED`
drafted.description: Use health checks and dependency conditions so Compose waits for Postgres instead of starting the app too early.
drafted.angle: Explain why `depends_on` only controls container start order and not service readiness, which leaves the app connecting before Postgres accepts connections. Show a healthcheck for Postgres, the correct `depends_on: condition: service_healthy` setup, and the fallback retry behavior the app should still keep.
